narrative.northStar: Tharros Canada: clear identity and inspectable research
narrative.overview: White ground, neutral ink, black broad surfaces and sparse burgundy give independent student research a contemporary presence. Home pairs the Tharros Canada name with a finite Canada–Europe line drawing, then a compact latest report, three separate provisional topics and two direct CTA boxes. About explains About, Mission, Why and Contact. Research areas owns the five subjects, while Methodology keeps the real worked trace and five rules without a public source directory. The earlier Open Questions and The open issue chooser selections remain historical context; the latest direct instructions govern.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, neutral ink and black surfaces with sparse burgundy actions and evidence states.
A large Tharros Canada identity and one finite connecting-line moment.
Compact latest research, three visibly draft upcoming topics and two direct homepage destinations.
Distinct short About, dedicated Research areas and useful evidence trace.
Real report covers; no rendered empty editorial frames; progressive reading paths.

rules.name: The White Ground Rule
rules.body: Let white space, dark typography and rules carry the page; burgundy identifies specific actions and states while large emphasis uses neutral ink.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Use the shared 64ch measure and purposeful local widths; do not stretch short copy across a column.

rules.name: The Visible Content Rule
rules.body: Reading order and explicit controls provide access; hover and motion never provide the only route.

rules.name: The Owner Imagery Rule
rules.body: Keep supplied covers faithful. Existing null optional imagery is retained but empty Home/About frames are not rendered; add owner imagery only when supplied.

dos: Use white ground, neutral ink, sparse burgundy and clear type.
Preserve real publication covers, supporting sources, Research tools and PDF controls.
Keep provisional upcoming ideas separate from publications and visibly labelled draft.
Keep complete no-JavaScript reading and reduced-motion static content.
Use direct Research wording and keep About short.
donts: Do not restore removed homepage essays, About reference inventories or the Methodology publisher directory.
Do not insert stock/generated placeholders or render empty editorial frames.
Do not invent publications, personal details, affiliations, findings or source dates.
Do not alter owner PDFs or unasked indexing choices.
Do not loop the hero animation, reveal essential content through motion or claim unverified QA.
